decision: Accept finite source/provenance boundary characterization, not rights clearance, service design approval or full E5 closure.

verification.limits: Hash/range and join verification is not semantic proof, package provenance, visual inspection, rights authorization or original backend access.

rootSemanticSamples.finding: Client sends retained bytes via token then upload; expiry is not validated, HTTPS source requires HTTPS upload and exact host including port; local non-HTTPS development is allowed. Upload result accepts any nonempty string, whereas later deletion validates 16..64 base64url characters and sends no auth header.
Explicit client-only endpoint-contract pointer, independent submission identity and retained NDJSON header; not private backend evidence.
Anonymous contact fields nulled; caller-supplied nonanonymous identity remains unverified. Exact JSON/multipart field selection and request timeout are client behavior, not durable server commit.
Reads latest source-file Git author timestamp, copies GIF/poster and emits metadata; does not establish capture time, rights or privacy.
Requires all 36 names and aggregate directory bytes <=11MiB; no content decoder, screenshot, creator or rights check.
16:10 object-cover poster/GIF and title fallback. Original checker success cannot prove useful animated demonstrations or accessibility.
Runtime package selection and pruning are source contracts; absence of a general LICENSE pruning rule does not prove final bundled renderer notices.
Renderer React/Tailwind, OXC minification and multi-entry build; no explicit notice-output step in sampled renderer block.
API/auth and infrastructure explicitly live in a different private repository; accepted local relay implementation does not cover them.

qualifications: AO-RIGHTS-01 remains external authorization unknown for applicable individual assets. No name/character/brand substitution or legal conclusion authorized.
AO-NOTICES-01 retains dependency/component provenance and exact distributable notice review. Five installed declarations are not authenticated upstream tarballs.
AO-RECORDINGS-01 maps all twelve roles but original capture content/permission remains unknown. Independent synthetic recordings are a proposal, not completed or approved media.

AO-SERVICE-01 establishes unavailable original backend source. Six replacement interfaces and policy values remain proposal-only; material ownership/region/retention/consent decisions require user discussion before provisioning.
PB-S2 production HTTPS is a proposed deployment constraint, not a claim the original client forbids local HTTP.
PB-S3/PB-S4 random 43-character deletion-capability tickets are proposed new service behavior; original upload response validation is weaker than later deletion validation.
PB-S1 transport and Unicode limits and PB-S5 adapter protocol are additions requiring conformance work, not existing server facts.
Do not reopen accepted local E5 contracts from historical inherited residual prose; complete E3 joins and whole-group reconciliation remain root-owned.

sourceChecker.classification: One unchanged original read-only standalone asset-integrity check run twice; not two new test cases, Vitest assertions, media playback or candidate parity.
sourceChecker.effects: Inspected complete script first; only source feature-wall directory listing/stat and stdout, no writes/imported product code/network/services.

lifecycle.release: retained external terminal; no process action; no new assignment

phase.next: Root integration review and two live bounded E3 joins, then whole E3/E5 acceptance; actual Sol implementation remains gated.
